# Screen catalog (generated by `npm run screens`; don't edit by hand)

Real VS360 web-app screens captured from vs360-webapp with fictional client data. Use the id as `screen` in a `screen` scene. Title and body are verified copy and are shown by default; override them only with claims you verified on necx.org or docs.necx.org.

| id | module | default title | default body |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dashboard` | dashboard | Your day at a glance | Caseload, shelter beds, the hotline and what needs attention, the moment staff sign in. |
| `cases-overview` | cases | One client, every service | Legal advocacy, a shelter bed and counseling for one client, held together in one case file. |
| `cases-consent` | cases | Demographics, by consent | Demographics are kept for each case. When the client has given consent, your edits save immediately. |
| `cases-documents` | cases | Documents for e-signature | Send documents for signature by the client, staff, or both. Clients sign in the NECX app. |
| `cases-notes` | cases | Case notes | Notes for your team, kept on the case. |
| `cases-chat` | cases | Secure case chat | Message the client right on the case. |
| `cases-staff` | cases | Staff tagging | Tag the staff working the case. |
| `cases-partners` | cases | Partner agency tagging | Tag the partner agencies in your network that are helping. |
| `cases-preassessment` | cases | Send a pre-assessment | Send it to a new or existing client in a few steps. |
| `referral-sharing` | referrals | Referrals: share only what you choose | Refer a case to a partner agency, and pick exactly what goes with it. |
| `hotline-command` | hotline | Your numbers, your lines | Dedicated hotline numbers for your agency, each line answered by your own team. |
| `hotline-callbacks` | hotline | Callbacks that don't slip | Every promised callback is scheduled with a date and owner. Overdue ones are flagged. |
| `hotline-missed` | hotline | No missed call forgotten | Missed calls wait in their own list, by line, ready to call back. |
| `hotline-log` | hotline | Every call, on the record | Line, staff, category and outcome for every call. Filter it, or export to CSV. |
| `hotline-analytics` | hotline | Know your line | Calls by day and hour, categories, staff performance and cases created. |
| `hotline-roles` | hotline | Private by design | You choose who gets hotline access, section by section. Transcript access is audit-logged. |
| `shelter-board` | shelters | A bed board, not a whiteboard | Available, occupied, reserved, maintenance, out of service. Tonight's count is the real count. |
| `shelter-checkin` | shelters | Walk-in check-in, in minutes | Checking in a new client creates their record on the spot. Shelter intake and case intake are one step. |
| `shelter-waitlist` | shelters | Waitlist, beside your beds | Priority, party size and bed preference, ready to assign when a bed opens. |
| `shelter-rollcall` | shelters | Nightly roll call | One card per stay, families included. Untick whoever didn't sleep here. |
| `shelter-transfer` | shelters | Transfers across locations | Move a client to any open bed, at any of your shelters. |
| `shelter-partners` | shelters | Partner shelters | See open beds at your partner agencies. Availability only, never bed details. |
| `shelter-app-requests` | shelters | Requests from the NECX app | Bed requests from clients' phones arrive in their own inbox: accept, waitlist or decline. |
| `shelter-incidents` | shelters | Incidents, on record | Log incidents by type and severity, right where they happened. |
| `reports-library` | reports | The NECX Reports Library | Every validator, funder report and grant tool your agency has, in one place. |
| `reports-grants` | reports | Grants, set up once | VOCA, FVPSA, VAWA STOP, HHSC: each grant with its program, contract dates and template. |
| `reports-case-grant` | reports | Every case, tagged to its grant | Each case carries its funding source, so services count toward the right grant from day one. |
| `reports-grant-form` | reports | The numbers funders ask for | Federal award number, state-assigned subaward number, project dates. |
| `reports-staff-hours` | reports | Staff time, by funding source | Hours logged against each grant, by staff member, for any date range. |
| `ai-builder` | reports | The NECX AI report builder | Board reports, grant progress reports, quarterly summaries, annual impact reports. |
| `ai-report` | reports | Built from your live data | Charts, KPIs, tables and narrative, in your agency's name. |
| `ai-accuracy` | reports | Every figure, traced | Each number is traced back to your database or files. Anything not in the source is flagged. |
| `board-charts` | reports | Ready to present | Trends by month, services by program, and breakdowns your board can read at a glance. |
| `voca-ready` | voca | VOCA: ready for sign-off | The OVC PMT screen sheet, built from logged VOCA services and case demographics, checked against OVC's own rules. |
| `voca-log-service` | voca | Log VOCA services as you go | Category A to E, subcategory, units and date, plus victim compensation help (Q6). |
| `voca-generate` | voca | Quarter end: pick and generate | Choose the grant, the federal fiscal year and the quarter. |
| `voca-sheet` | voca | Q1 to Q6, done | Individuals served, new individuals, victimizations and compensation help. |
| `voca-reminders` | voca | Never miss a quarter | Federal fiscal quarters and due-date reminders, right on the page. |
| `hud-projects` | hud | Set up once for HUD | Your HMIS organization ID, and HUD 2.01: a victim service provider reporting from a comparable database. |
| `hud-rollcall` | hud | Bed nights, every night | The nightly roll call records who slept here (HUD 4.14). |
| `hud-missing` | hud | Missing HUD Data | Who in the project is still missing HUD elements, and a link to fix each one. |
| `hud-sage-ready` | hud | Ready for Sage submission | The APR is built from your records and checked the way Sage checks it. |
| `hud-sage-rules` | hud | Checked file by file | Header, row and column counts, and HUD's rules for every table. |
| `fvpsa-report` | fvpsa | FVPSA PPR, filled from your records | Shelter nights from your bed board, crisis calls from your hotline, with last year's figure beside each one. |
| `fvpsa-explain` | fvpsa | Explain any number | Every roll-call night behind a number, and every record left out, with the reason. |
| `fvpsa-quality` | fvpsa | Checked before you certify | Big changes from last year are flagged for review. |
| `stop-home` | stop | The STOP report | STOP and SASP subgrantee annual progress reports, in one place. |
| `stop-victims` | stop | Victims served, calculated | Victims seeking services by victimization: served, partially served, and not served. |
| `stop-legal` | stop | Legal matters and protection orders | Legal issues, providers and outcomes, and protection orders requested and granted. |
| `stop-quality` | stop | Checked before approval | Large year-over-year changes are flagged for review. |
| `hhsc-generate` | hhsc | Pick the month, generate | NECX builds the month's DAL7 files from your own records and checks them. Ready for sign-off. |
| `hhsc-files` | hhsc | All 11 DAL7 files | Line counts, records passed and failed, and warnings, file by file. |
| `hhsc-hotline` | hhsc | Hotline calls, by HHSC topic | Each call's wrap-up records the HHSC call topic for the hotline report. |
| `vclg-quality` | vclg | Caught before the OAG sees it | A hospital accompaniment under 45 minutes, a service by unfunded staff, a missing age. |
| `vclg-signoff` | vclg | Signed by the Grant Contact | Section 7 data verification: initials and date go into the workbook. |
| `staff-roles` | access | Roles that fit your agency | Each role lists the modules it opens, and where it applies: VS360 Web, the Workspace app, or both. |
| `staff-role-actions` | access | Down to each action | This case manager can view, add and edit cases, but not delete them. Without View all, they see new cases and the ones they handle. |
| `staff-team` | access | Your whole team | Everyone on staff, with their role and whether they're active. |
| `staff-offboard` | access | When someone leaves | Change their role, switch their code to text, or deactivate them in one click. |
| `calendar-month` | calendar | Your whole month | Appointments, court dates and hotline callbacks on one calendar, colored by priority. |
| `calendar-court` | calendar | Reminders for staff and client | Remind the team and the client before it starts: in the app, by email, or both. |
| `time-hours` | calendar | Hours by funding source | Hours per grant and per staff member, for any date range, ready for your funders. |
| `notes-list` | notes | Every note, one place | Every case note across your caseload, with today, this week and this month at a glance. |
| `drive` | drive | One drive, every view | My Drive, Shared with me, Agency Drive and Starred, side by side. |
| `drive-links` | drive | Links that expire | Share links expire after 1, 7 or 30 days, and you can revoke any link whenever you want. |
| `network` | network | Your Network | Agencies on NECX, with the services they offer and whether they're accepting referrals. |
| `network-chat` | network | Chat with partner agencies | Agency chats are shared by the staff at both agencies, so no one works alone. |
| `services-catalog` | services | Your service catalog | Every service your agency offers, grouped by category. |
